channel.title: Diurna — Corrections and updates
channel.description: Every change made to a story after publication, with the time and the reason.

item.title: What changed — In Shenzhen, Trump, Xi and Putin issue a "peace declaration" silent on Ukraine and Iran
item.description:
The three-way meeting took place: title, text, figure, modules and keys rewritten after the "peace declaration" was issued.

In Shenzhen, Trump, Xi and Putin issue a "peace declaration" silent on Ukraine and Iran

item.title: What changed — Iran says it targeted an American radar in Bahrain as more tankers burn in Hormuz
item.description:
The Guards say they targeted an American radar in Bahrain and Tehran reports three tankers ablaze; headline and text rewritten.

Iran says it targeted an American radar in Bahrain as more tankers burn in Hormuz

item.title: What changed — Donald Trump lands in Manila for the close of the ASEAN summit, before heading to Shenzhen
item.description:
Donald Trump has arrived in Manila and convened the Quad; standfirst and text rewritten in the past tense.

Donald Trump lands in Manila for the close of the ASEAN summit, before heading to Shenzhen

item.title: What changed — A section of the Crimean bridge collapses as Russia strikes Kyiv’s bridges
item.description:
Another Ukrainian strike brought down part of the Crimean bridge and Russia struck Kyiv; headline and text rewritten.

A section of the Crimean bridge collapses as Russia strikes Kyiv’s bridges

item.title: What changed — Iran says six tankers have hit mines near Hormuz as a third American carrier arrives
item.description:
The Guards say six tankers have struck mines since Sunday and a third American carrier has arrived; headline and text rewritten.

Iran says six tankers have hit mines near Hormuz as a third American carrier arrives

item.title: What changed — Ukraine launches its biggest drone attack on Russia, reaching as far as the Crimean bridge
item.description:
Moscow says it intercepted a record 1,336 Ukrainian drones and the Kerch bridge was targeted; headline, text and figure of the day rewritten.

Ukraine launches its biggest drone attack on Russia, reaching as far as the Crimean bridge

item.title: What changed — Iran says it hit an American radar in Bahrain as Donald Trump rules out a deal
item.description:
The Revolutionary Guards claim to have targeted an American radar in Bahrain after a strike on Sirik; headline, standfirst and third sentence rewritten.

Iran says it hit an American radar in Bahrain as Donald Trump rules out a deal

item.title: What changed — After seeing Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump’s envoys head to Dublin to meet Volodymyr Zelensky
item.description:
America’s envoys have met Vladimir Putin; headline, standfirst and text rewritten in the light of the Kremlin’s readout.

After seeing Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump’s envoys head to Dublin to meet Volodymyr Zelensky

item.title: What changed — Israel is reportedly readying a strike on Iran as two supertankers explode in Hormuz
item.description:
Israel is reportedly readying a strike on Iran and two supertankers exploded in Hormuz; headline, text and figure rewritten.

Israel is reportedly readying a strike on Iran as two supertankers explode in Hormuz

item.title: What changed — Russia and Ukraine agree a vast prisoner exchange in Abu Dhabi, but no breakthrough
item.description:
The talks ended with a prisoner-exchange deal but no breakthrough; headline, text, figure and timetable rewritten.

Russia and Ukraine agree a vast prisoner exchange in Abu Dhabi, but no breakthrough

item.title: What changed — Indonesia’s vice-president, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, resigns amid doubts over his diplomas
item.description:
The vice-president handed in his resignation on Wednesday; headline, text, figure of the day and modules rewritten.

Indonesia’s vice-president, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, resigns amid doubts over his diplomas

item.title: What changed — Paraguay’s Santiago Peña is removed and confined to his home as Pedro Alliana takes over
item.description:
Santiago Peña appeared before prosecutors on Saturday morning; text and sources updated.

Paraguay’s Santiago Peña is removed and confined to his home as Pedro Alliana takes over

item.title: What changed — America strikes Iranian air defences in the Strait of Hormuz as Tehran vows to respond
item.description:
Washington struck an Iranian air-defence system on Qeshm island and Tehran vows to respond: headline and text rewritten.

America strikes Iranian air defences in the Strait of Hormuz as Tehran vows to respond

item.title: What changed — Paraguay’s Senate opens Santiago Peña’s impeachment trial after his bid to resign fails
item.description:
Santiago Peña’s resignation failed for lack of a quorum and the Senate opened his trial: headline, text and number of the day updated.

Paraguay’s Senate opens Santiago Peña’s impeachment trial after his bid to resign fails

item.title: What changed — Russia strikes civilians and the power grid in Ukraine ahead of new talks
item.description:
Added the Russian strike on a school in the Zaporizhzhia region that killed at least 43 people; headline, number of the day and toll updated.

Russia strikes civilians and the power grid in Ukraine ahead of new talks

item.title: What changed — In Israel, Gadi Eisenkot wins the backing of most MPs against Benjamin Netanyahu
item.description:
Gadi Eisenkot wins the recommendations of 67 MPs against 46 for Benjamin Netanyahu: headline, text and number of the day rewritten.

In Israel, Gadi Eisenkot wins the backing of most MPs against Benjamin Netanyahu
